headline: Revenue climbs but per-share profit slips year over year
summary_short: Revenue rose to $438.3M, up 32.1% y/y, while diluted EPS fell to $0.20 from $0.22 a year ago even as operating margin expanded to 7.8% from 6.6%.
summary_long: Revenue was $438.3M, up 32.1% y/y and 59.4% q/q. Gross profit rose to $111.2M (+32.3% y/y), with gross margin roughly flat at 25.4% versus 25.3% a year ago. Operating income increased to $34.1M (+56.2% y/y), expanding operating margin to 7.8% from 6.6%. EBITDA grew to $59.6M (+39.7% y/y). Net income was $23.6M, down 8.3% y/y, and diluted EPS fell to $0.20 from $0.22 (-9.1% y/y), even as net income and EPS both rose sharply on a sequential basis from the prior quarter.
